items.en: We're overbooked on this flight. Would you be willing to take a later one?
items.ja: この便はオーバーブッキングでして。後の便に変更していただけませんか？ →「条件によります。何か補償はありますか？」
items.speaker: orville
choices: That depends. Is there any compensation?
No, I booked it months ago.
Yes, a window seat, please.
items.note: overbooked＝定員超過の予約。まず条件を聞くのが自然

items.en: I'm afraid your room isn't quite ready yet.
items.ja: 申し訳ございません、お部屋の準備がまだ整っておりません。 →「大丈夫です。荷物を預けてもいいですか？」
items.speaker: diana
choices: No problem. Can I leave my bags here?
That's all right, I'm ready.
Yes, I'm afraid of heights.
items.note: I'm afraid＝残念ながら。怖いという意味ではない

items.en: Are you taking anything else right now?
items.ja: 今、ほかに飲んでいるお薬はありますか？ →「血圧の薬だけです。」
items.speaker: merengue
choices: Just something for my blood pressure.
No, I'll take it now.
Yes, a bag, please.
items.note: take＝薬を飲む。レジの「ほかに何か？」と混同しやすい

items.en: The earliest I can do is Thursday, but you can drop the bike off anytime before then.
items.ja: いちばん早くて木曜ですね。それまでなら、自転車はいつ持ってきてもらっても大丈夫です。 →「木曜でいいです。じゃあ明日持っていってもいいですか？」
items.speaker: julian
choices: Thursday works. Can I bring it in tomorrow, then?
No, I dropped it on Thursday.
The earliest train is fine.
items.note: The earliest I can do is…＝最短で〜。予約枠の言い方

items.en: We can move it, but just so you know, there's a fee for changes within 24 hours.
items.ja: 変更はできますが、念のため、24時間以内の変更には手数料がかかります。 →「あ、おいくらですか？」
items.speaker: coco
choices: Ah. How much would that be?
Thursday at four is fine.
Sure, I know the way.
items.note: just so you know＝念のため。後ろが本題
items.tts: We can move it, but just so you know, there's a fee for changes within twenty-four hours.

items.en: The cabinets should come in sometime next week, so we'll start after that. Depends on the supplier.
items.ja: 戸棚は来週のどこかで届くはずなので、作業はそのあとですね。業者しだいです。 →「日にちを決めてもらえませんか？その週末に両親が来るんです。」
items.speaker: tom-nook
choices: Any chance you could pin down a day? My parents are visiting that weekend.
Yes, the cabinets look great.
Sure, I'll supply the coffee.
items.note: sometime next week は曖昧。日を確定させる返しが自然

items.en: Hey, not a big deal, but I think your car's kind of in my spot.
items.ja: あの、大したことじゃないんだけど、君の車、ちょっと僕の駐車スペースに入ってるみたい。 →「あっ、ごめん！すぐ動かすね。」
items.speaker: apollo
choices: Oh, sorry! I'll move it right now.
Yeah, I got a great deal on it.
Sure, there's a spot over there.
items.note: not a big deal, but…は遠回しな苦情。but の後が本題
items.tts: Hey, not a big deal, but I think your car's kinda in my spot.

items.en: We've got like twelve more people coming. Mind grabbing some chairs from the garage?
items.ja: あと12人くらい来るんだ。ガレージから椅子を持ってきてもらえる？ →「いいよ。何脚いる？」
items.speaker: punchy
choices: Sure. How many do you need?
Twenty? That's a lot of people.
No, I don't mind the garage.
items.note: Mind ~ing?＝〜してくれる？ Sure で引き受け

items.en: Sorry, you cut out there for a second. Could you say that last part again?
items.ja: すみません、今ちょっと音声が途切れて。最後のところ、もう一度いいですか？ →「はい、ローンチを5月に延ばそうと言いました。」
items.speaker: raymond
choices: Sure. I said we should push the launch to May.
Yes, I cut it out myself.
Just a second, I'll check.
items.note: cut out＝音声が途切れる。ビデオ会議の定番

items.en: Do anything fun over the weekend?
items.ja: 週末、何か楽しいことした？ →「特に。家でのんびりしてたよ。そっちは？」
items.speaker: ankha
choices: Not really, just hung out at home. You?
Yes, it's really fun, thanks.
I'll do it this weekend.
items.note: Did you の省略。月曜の雑談の定番

items.en: We should get coffee one of these days.
items.ja: 近いうちにコーヒーでも行こうよ。 →「ぜひ。空いてる日、教えて。」
items.speaker: whitney
choices: Yeah, definitely. Let me know when you're free.
I got one already, thanks.
Most days, yeah.
items.note: 社交辞令のことも多い。軽く乗っておくのが無難

items.en: Friday might be a little tricky, to be honest.
items.ja: 正直、金曜はちょっと厳しいかもしれないね。 →「では、月曜の朝はいかがですか？」
items.speaker: pietro
choices: Would Monday morning work instead?
Yes, it's a tricky question.
To be honest, I'm free on Friday.
items.note: a little tricky は遠回しの「無理」。代案を出す

items.en: The report's great overall. I'd just maybe tighten up the summary a little.
items.ja: 全体的にはいいレポートだね。ただ、要約をもう少し締めてもいいかも。 →「了解です。短くして送り直します。」
items.speaker: goldie
choices: Got it. I'll shorten it and send it again.
Thanks! So it's finished, then?
It's a little tight, yes.
items.note: maybe・a little は柔らかい指示。直すのが正解

items.en: You're coming to my housewarming on Saturday, right?
items.ja: 土曜の引っ越し祝い、来てくれるよね？ →「行けたら行くね。約束はできないけど。」
items.speaker: bunnie
choices: I'll try to make it, but no promises.
Right, it'll be warm on Saturday.
Yes, I came on Saturday.
items.note: housewarming＝新居祝い。天気の warm ではない

items.en: I'm so sorry, something's come up. Can we do Thursday instead?
items.ja: ほんとにごめん、急用ができちゃって。木曜にしてもいい？ →「気にしないで。木曜で大丈夫。」
items.speaker: rosie
choices: No problem. Thursday works for me.
Sure, come on up.
It came up on Thursday.
items.note: something's come up＝急用ができた。断りの定番

items.en: Sorry, how many in your party? It's super loud in here tonight.
items.ja: すみません、何名様ですか？今夜はここ、すごくうるさくて。 →「4人です。タナカで予約してます。」
items.speaker: kid-cat
choices: Four. It's under Tanaka.
Yeah, it's a great party!
Yeah, it's really loud tonight.
items.note: party＝一行の人数。うるさい話に乗らない

items.en: Thai or Italian? Honestly, I could go either way.
items.ja: タイ料理かイタリアン、どっちにする？正直どっちでもいいよ。 →「じゃあタイにしよう。お腹ぺこぺこ。」
items.speaker: cherry
choices: Let's do Thai, then. I'm starving.
Honestly, I'm not Italian.
No, I'm going the other way.
items.note: could go either way＝どっちでもいい

items.en: My boss moved the deadline up again. I'm so done with this job.
items.ja: 上司がまた締め切りを早めたの。もうこの仕事、うんざり。 →「それはきついね。話、聞こうか？」
items.speaker: audie
choices: Ugh, that's rough. Want to talk about it?
Nice! So you finished early?
Up? Which floor are you on?
items.note: I'm so done with～＝うんざり。終わったではない

items.en: Excuse me, is this the right way for the Ginza Line?
items.ja: すみません、銀座線はこっちで合ってますか？ →「もうすぐです。左の階段を下りてください。」
items.speaker: maple
choices: Almost. It's down those stairs on your left.
Yes, the line's really long.
No, I came by taxi.
items.note: line＝路線。行列の line と取り違えない

items.en: Without proof of address, I can't renew your license today, I'm afraid.
items.ja: 住所を証明するものがないと、申し訳ありませんが本日は免許の更新ができません。 →「スマホの銀行明細でも大丈夫ですか？」
items.speaker: mabel
choices: Would a bank statement on my phone work?
Great, so I can pick it up today?
I'll pay by card, then.
items.note: proof of address＝住所の証明。代わりを提案する

items.en: Heads up, there's an automatic 18% tip on here. Did you see that?
items.ja: ねえ、18%のチップが自動で加算されてるよ。気づいてた？ →「えっ、じゃあ別にチップを置かなくていいんだ。」
items.speaker: apollo
choices: Oh! So we don't need to tip on top of that.
Yeah, I saw it on TV.
About eighteen of us, I think.
items.note: automatic tip＝自動加算のチップ。二重に払わない
items.tts: Heads up, there's an automatic eighteen percent tip on here. Didja see that?

items.en: We could upgrade you to a suite. For a small additional charge, of course.
items.ja: スイートにアップグレードもできますよ。もちろん、少々追加料金はかかりますが。 → つまり、払えばいい部屋にできる。
items.speaker: diana
choices: You can have a better room if you pay extra.
You're getting a free upgrade.
The suite is smaller than your room.
items.note: for a small charge＝有料。無料と早合点しない

items.en: I'll see what I can do, but I can't promise anything.
items.ja: できるだけのことはしますが、お約束はできません。 → つまり、やってはみるが期待しないでほしい。
items.speaker: pietro
choices: He'll try, but it may not happen.
He's sure he can fix it.
He wants to see it in person.
items.note: see what I can do は「やってはみる」。保証ではない

items.en: That movie? Oh, it was just great. Two hours of my life I'll never get back.
items.ja: あの映画？ いやあ、最高だったよ。二度と戻ってこない2時間だね。 → つまり、時間の無駄だった。
items.speaker: raymond
choices: He thought the movie was a waste of time.
He loved the movie.
He wants to watch it again.
items.note: just great は皮肉。後半が本音

items.en: So the client's files are gone? Well, that's not ideal.
items.ja: クライアントのファイルが消えた？うーん、それは理想的とは言えないね。 → つまり、かなりまずい。
items.speaker: ankha
choices: It's a serious problem.
It's a small, unimportant issue.
She has a better idea.
items.note: not ideal は控えめな言い方。実はかなり深刻

items.en: Honestly? Not bad at all. I'd change one or two slides, but that's it.
items.ja: 正直？全然悪くないよ。スライドを1、2枚直すくらいかな。 → つまり、ほぼこのままでいい。
items.speaker: whitney
choices: Your slides are good, with a few small changes.
Your slides aren't good enough yet.
She hasn't seen the slides yet.
items.note: not bad at all＝かなり良い。否定に引きずられない

items.en: I'm good with whatever. Well, maybe not sushi again.
items.ja: なんでもいいよ。…まあ、またお寿司じゃなければ。 → つまり、寿司以外がいい。
items.speaker: goldie
choices: She'd rather not have sushi.
She really wants sushi.
She thinks she's good at making sushi.
items.note: good with whatever＝何でもいい。でも最後に本音

items.en: Saturday? Yeah, I'll try and swing by, if I'm not too beat.
items.ja: 土曜？うん、疲れてなかったら寄ってみるよ。 → つまり、たぶん来ない。
items.speaker: kid-cat
choices: He probably won't come.
He'll definitely come.
He'll come by car.
items.note: try and／if… は不参加の予防線。beat＝くたくた
items.tts: Saturday? Yeah, I'll try 'n' swing by, if I'm not too beat.

items.en: Cake? Oh, I'd better not. I'm watching what I eat this month.
items.ja: ケーキ？やめとこうかな。今月は食べるものに気をつけてるの。 → つまり、ダイエット中なので断っている。
items.speaker: bunnie
choices: She's saying no because she's on a diet.
She'll watch the others eat cake.
She loves cake, so she's in.
items.note: watching what I eat＝食事制限中。better not＝断り
items.tts: Cake? Oh, I'd better not. I'm watchin' what I eat this month.

items.en: Is it just me, or is it freezing in here?
items.ja: 私だけかな、ここすごく寒くない？ → つまり、暖房を上げてほしい。
items.speaker: molly
choices: She'd like the heat turned up.
She thinks she's getting sick.
She wants ice in her drink.
items.note: Is it just me, or…＝遠回しな依頼や同意集め

items.en: Hey, it's me. Long story, but, um, any chance you could feed my cat tomorrow?
items.ja: もしもし、俺。話せば長いんだけど、えーと、明日うちの猫にエサあげてもらえないかな？ → つまり、頼み事をしている。
items.speaker: sherb
choices: He's asking you for a favor.
He wants to tell you a long story.
He's asking if you like cats.
items.note: Any chance you could～?＝遠慮がちな頼み方
items.tts: Hey, it's me. Long story, but, um, any chance ya could feed my cat tomorrow?

items.en: That's actually handled by a different department. Let me put you through.
items.ja: そちらは実は別の窓口の担当なんです。おつなぎしますね。 → つまり、電話を転送する。
items.speaker: maple
choices: She's going to transfer your call.
She'll handle it herself.
She's about to end the call.
items.note: put you through＝電話をつなぐ。通過や合格ではない
items.tts: That's actually handled by a different department. Lemme put you through.

items.en: Before I cancel that for you, can I offer you three months at half price?
items.ja: 解約の前に、3か月半額のご提案をさせていただけますか？ → つまり、引き止めようとしている。
items.speaker: pietro
choices: He's trying to get you to stay.
He's already canceled it.
He's charging you for three months.
items.note: Before I cancel…は引き止めの定番。まだ解約前

items.en: Your package is being held. You just need to pay a small release fee, by gift card.
items.ja: お荷物が保留になっております。少額の手数料をギフトカードでお支払いください。 → つまり、おそらく詐欺。
items.speaker: redd
choices: It's almost certainly a scam.
Your package is free to pick up.
He's sending you a gift.
items.note: ギフトカード払いの要求は詐欺の典型

items.en: Honestly, those pans are better off soaking. They'll be way easier to wash tomorrow.
items.ja: 正直、あの鍋はつけ置きしたほうがいいって。明日のほうがずっと洗いやすいよ。 → つまり、今夜は洗わない。
items.speaker: tom-nook
choices: He isn't going to wash them tonight.
He'll wash them right now.
He thinks the pans are ruined.
items.note: better off soaking は先延ばしの言い訳

items.en: That's an interesting idea. It's not quite what we agreed, though.
items.ja: 面白いアイデアですね。ただ、合意した内容とは少し違いますね。 → つまり、その変更は受け入れない。
items.speaker: julian
choices: He won't accept the change.
He likes the idea and agrees to it.
He's forgotten what you agreed.
items.note: interesting＋though は丁寧な反対

items.en: You're going to the gym? Today? Somebody alert the media.
items.ja: ジムに行くの？今日？誰かマスコミに知らせて。 → つまり、めったに行かないとからかっている。
items.speaker: cherry
choices: She's joking that you hardly ever go.
She thinks the gym will be on the news.
She's worried you'll get hurt.
items.note: alert the media＝珍しい出来事だとからかう冗談

items.en: Good, good. Maybe just not quite so fast on the way down.
items.ja: いいね、いいね。下ろすときはもう少しゆっくりでもいいかな。 → つまり、ゆっくり下ろして。
items.speaker: roald
choices: Lower the weight more slowly.
Lift the weight faster.
You're doing it perfectly. Keep going.
items.note: Good＋maybe は柔らかい修正指示

items.en: Due to the wind, this afternoon's sailings are suspended until further notice.
items.ja: 強風のため、本日午後の便は追ってお知らせするまで運航を見合わせます。 → つまり、当面フェリーは出ない。
items.speaker: kappn
choices: No ferries are leaving for now.
The ferry is leaving a little late.
Only the morning ferry is canceled.
items.note: suspended＝運休。until further notice＝当面

items.en: You should've checked the gate before going for coffee.
items.ja: コーヒーを買いに行く前に、搭乗口を確認しておくべきだったね。
items.speaker: wilbur
choices: should've
shouldn't have
could've
items.note: should've は「シュダ」。shouldn't なら n't が聞こえる
items.tts: You shoulda checked the gate before goin' for coffee.

items.en: I wouldn't have booked it if I'd known about the fee.
items.ja: 手数料のことを知ってたら、予約しなかったのに。
items.speaker: coco
choices: wouldn't have
would've
couldn't have
items.note: wouldn't have は t が消えて「ウドゥナヴ」
items.tts: I wouldn't've booked it if I'd known about the fee.

items.en: We can't see you before Thursday.
items.ja: 木曜より前には診察できません。
items.speaker: julian
choices: can't
can
couldn't
items.note: can't は t が飲まれ、母音が強く長い。can は弱く「クン」

items.en: Do you want to order in tonight?
items.ja: 今夜はデリバリーにする？
items.speaker: molly
choices: want to
have to
need to
items.note: wanna＝want to。hafta（have to）と聞き分け
items.tts: D'you wanna order in tonight?

items.en: You've got to transfer at Shinagawa for the airport.
items.ja: 空港へは品川で乗り換えないといけないよ。
items.speaker: kappn
choices: You've got to
You don't need to
You'd have to
items.note: gotta＝got to（〜しなきゃ）。'd have to は仮定
items.tts: You've gotta transfer at Shinagawa for the airport.

items.en: Did you pack this bag yourself?
items.ja: このバッグはご自身で荷造りされましたか？
items.speaker: orville
choices: Did you
Do you
Would you
items.note: Did you は「ディジャ」とつながる
items.tts: Didja pack this bag yourself?

items.en: Size nine? Here you go. Just bring them back to the counter when you're done.
items.ja: サイズ9ですね、どうぞ。終わったらカウンターに返してください。
items.speaker: mabel
choices: them
him
it
items.note: them は「エム」に弱まる。'im（him）と紛らわしい
items.tts: Size nine? Here you go. Just bring 'em back to the counter when you're done.

items.en: We've got a lot of work to get through today.
items.ja: 今日は片付けなきゃいけない仕事がたくさんあるぞ。
items.speaker: pietro
choices: a lot of
a little
lots of
items.note: a lot of は「アラダ」。a little も「アリル」に
items.tts: We've got a lotta work to get through today.

items.en: We're going to start boarding shortly.
items.ja: まもなく搭乗を開始いたします。
items.speaker: orville
choices: We're going to
We were going to
We want to
items.note: We're gonna と We were gonna は were の弱音で差
items.tts: We're gonna start boarding shortly.

items.en: I can make it any time after two.
items.ja: 2時以降なら、いつでも伺えます。
items.speaker: stitches
choices: can
can't
can only
items.note: 米国の can't は t がほぼ消える。母音の強さで判断

items.en: I'd ask the tailor before you try hemming them yourself.
items.ja: 自分で裾上げする前に、私なら仕立て屋さんに聞くよ。
items.speaker: goldie
choices: I'd
I'll
We'll
items.note: I'd＝私なら〜する（助言）。I'll＝今から私が聞く

items.en: You'll need to fill out a customs form for that.
items.ja: そちらは税関申告書のご記入が必要です。
items.speaker: merengue
choices: You'll need to
You don't need to
You needed to
items.note: You'll の ll は弱い。don't の有無を聞く

items.en: The weather's supposed to get better later.
items.ja: 天気、あとで良くなるらしいよ。
items.speaker: ankha
choices: better
wetter
bitter
items.note: 米国の t は母音の間で弾み「ベダー」に。b／w と母音を聞く

items.en: I don't know. Maybe the Thai place?
items.ja: わかんない、タイ料理の店とか？
items.speaker: sherb
choices: don't know
don't mind
don't care
items.note: dunno＝don't know。don't mind と区別
items.tts: Dunno, maybe the Thai place?

items.en: Let me just pull up your account.
items.ja: お客様のアカウントをお調べしますね。
items.speaker: maple
choices: Let me
Let's
Let him
items.note: lemme＝let me。let 'im（let him）と似る
items.tts: Lemme just pull up your account.

items.en: The helmet's 40 bucks, so with tax you're looking at $43.20.
items.ja: ヘルメットは40ドルなので、税込みだと43ドル20セントですね。
items.speaker: kappn
items.note: 税込みの合計が答え。forty-three twenty＝43.20
items.tts: The helmet's forty bucks, so with tax you're lookin' at forty-three twenty.

items.en: Flight 815 to Denver is now boarding at gate 50. Sorry, gate 15.
items.ja: デンバー行き815便は、50番…失礼しました、15番搭乗口で搭乗中です。
items.speaker: orville
choices: 8番
items.note: 訂正後が答え。fifTEEN／FIFty の強勢
items.tts: Flight eight fifteen to Denver is now boarding at gate fifty. Sorry — gate fifteen.

items.en: That comes to $8.49. Do you need a bag?
items.ja: 8ドル49セントになります。袋はご入用ですか？
items.speaker: merengue
items.note: 米国はドルを省いて「エイト・フォーティナイン」
items.tts: That comes to eight forty-nine. D'you need a bag?

items.en: Parts and labor, you're looking at about $340.
items.ja: 部品代と工賃で、だいたい340ドルですね。
items.speaker: stitches
items.note: three-forty＝340ドル。会話では hundred を省く
items.tts: Parts and labor, you're lookin' at about three-forty.

items.en: It'd be ¥68,000, plus another ¥5,000 if you need us to pack.
items.ja: 6万8千円です。梱包もご希望なら、さらに5千円かかります。

lines.ja: 感謝祭には何を持っていけばいい？ワイン？花？

lines.en: Honestly, just bring yourself. My mom's been cooking since Tuesday.
lines.ja: 正直、手ぶらでいいよ。母が火曜から料理してるから。

lines.en: Come on, I can't show up empty-handed.
lines.ja: そんな、手ぶらで行けないよ。

items.en: What do you want to do this weekend? Oh, I'm easy. Whatever you want. Great. How about the ballgame on Saturday, then? Hmm... we went to a game last weekend.
items.ja: それもそうだね。じゃあ君が選んで。
items.speaker: apollo
choices: Fair enough. You pick, then.
Awesome, so Saturday it is.
Last weekend? No, it was the weekend before.
items.ask: つぎの ひとことは？
items.note: I'm easy＝なんでもいい。でも本音は別

lines.en: What do you want to do this weekend?
lines.ja: 週末、何したい？

lines.en: Oh, I'm easy. Whatever you want.
lines.ja: なんでもいいよ。あなたの好きなので。

lines.en: Great. How about the ballgame on Saturday, then?
lines.ja: よし。じゃあ土曜は野球観戦は？

lines.en: Hmm... we went to a game last weekend.
lines.ja: うーん…先週も試合に行ったよね。

items.en: Your room won't be ready till three, I'm afraid. Ah. My meeting's at two, so I was hoping to change first. We do have a suite available now, for a small fee. How small are we talking?
items.ja: スイートの追加料金がいくらか。
items.speaker: merengue
choices: How much extra the suite costs.
Whether the meeting room is free.
What time his room will be ready.
items.ask: 男性が 知りたいことは？
items.note: for a small fee＝有料。How small…?＝いくら？

lines.en: Your room won't be ready till three, I'm afraid.
lines.ja: 申し訳ありませんが、お部屋は3時までご用意できません。

lines.en: Ah. My meeting's at two, so I was hoping to change first.
lines.ja: ああ。2時に会議があって、先に着替えたかったんですが。

lines.en: We do have a suite available now, for a small fee.
lines.ja: 少々の追加料金で、今すぐご利用いただけるスイートもございます。

lines.en: How small are we talking?
lines.ja: 少しって、どのくらいです？

items.en: Hi, this is Mark from your bank's fraud team. We've blocked a suspicious payment. Oh. Which payment? I'll explain in a sec. First, just read me the code we texted you, to confirm it's you. Hang on. I'll call the number on the back of my card.
items.ja: 自分で銀行に電話して確かめる。
items.speaker: redd
choices: Call the bank himself to check.
Read out the code he was sent.
Ask which payment was blocked.
items.focus: call the number on the back of my card
items.ask: 男性は このあと どうする？
items.note: コードを聞き出す「銀行」は詐欺のサイン。自分でかけ直す

lines.en: Hi, this is Mark from your bank's fraud team. We've blocked a suspicious payment.
lines.ja: 銀行の不正対策チームのマークです。不審な支払いをブロックしました。

lines.en: Oh. Which payment?
lines.ja: えっ。どの支払いですか？

lines.en: I'll explain in a sec. First, just read me the code we texted you, to confirm it's you.
lines.ja: すぐご説明します。まず本人確認のため、送ったコードを読み上げてください。

lines.en: Hang on. I'll call the number on the back of my card.
lines.ja: 待ってください。カードの裏の番号にかけ直します。

items.en: Is the four o'clock ferry still going? It's pretty windy out there. Afraid not, it's been called off. The next one's at six, weather permitting. And if that one's canceled too?
items.ja: その場合は、今夜のホテルをご用意します。
items.speaker: cherry
choices: Then we'll put you up in a hotel for the night.
Yes, it's at six, weather permitting.
Don't worry, the wind's from the west.
items.ask: つぎの ひとことは？
items.note: called off＝中止。put you up＝泊める

lines.en: Is the four o'clock ferry still going? It's pretty windy out there.
lines.ja: 4時のフェリーはまだ出ますか？ 外かなり風が強いですけど。

lines.en: Afraid not, it's been called off. The next one's at six, weather permitting.
lines.ja: 残念ながら欠航です。次は6時、天候次第ですね。

lines.en: And if that one's canceled too?
lines.ja: それも欠航になったら？

items.en: Did you want to pick it up in the store, or have it shipped to your house?
items.ja: 店舗で受け取りますか、それともご自宅に配送しますか？ →「配送でお願いします。車がないので。」
items.speaker: tia
choices: Shipped, please. I don't have a car.
Yes, I picked it up yesterday.
It's a two-story house.
items.note: A or B の質問。Yes/No では答えにならない
items.tts: Didja wanna pick it up in the store, or have it shipped to your house?

items.en: You're welcome to bring your own, but there's a $20 corkage fee per bottle.
items.ja: お持ち込みは可能ですが、1本につき20ドルの持ち込み料がかかります。 →「なるほど。じゃあ、リストから頼みます。」
items.speaker: hamlet
choices: Fair enough. We'll just order off the list, then.
Twenty bottles? That's a lot.
No thanks, I brought my own cork.
items.note: corkage＝持ち込み料。but の後が本題
items.tts: You're welcome to bring your own, but there's a twenty-dollar corkage fee per bottle.

items.en: Our card reader's acting up. Got any cash on you?
items.ja: カードリーダーの調子が悪くて。現金、お持ちですか？ →「1セントもないです。近くにATMありますか？」
items.speaker: bud
choices: Not a cent, sorry. Is there an ATM nearby?
Sure, I'll just put it on my card.
Yeah, he's been acting up all day.
items.note: acting up＝調子が悪い。on you＝手持ち
items.tts: Our card reader's actin' up. Got any cash on ya?

items.en: Should I put a hold on your card for incidentals, or would you rather leave a cash deposit?
items.ja: 雑費の保証としてカードを仮押さえしますか、それとも現金のデポジットになさいますか？ →「カードで。仮押さえはいつ解除されますか？」
items.speaker: keaton
choices: The card's fine. When does the hold come off?
I'd rather not hold on, thanks.
Yes, I deposited it this morning.
items.note: incidentals＝客室の雑費。hold＝カードの仮押さえ

items.en: The only two spots left on the boat are up on the top deck. It gets pretty windy up there, just so you know.
items.ja: ボートで残っている2席は上のデッキだけです。念のため、上はかなり風が強いですよ。 →「大丈夫です。上着を持っていきます。」
items.speaker: ken
choices: Fine by us. We'll bring jackets.
Great, we'll take the bottom deck, then.
No thanks, I already know.
items.note: just so you know の後が条件。受けるか断るか

items.en: Has anyone told you not to drink while you're on these?
items.ja: この薬を飲んでいる間は、お酒を控えるよう言われましたか？ →「いいえ、何も。まずいですか？」
items.speaker: pashmina
choices: No, nobody mentioned it. Is that a problem?
Just water, thanks.
I've been on them since Tuesday.
items.note: drink＝お酒。on these＝この薬を服用中

items.en: And how long has this been going on, roughly?
items.ja: それで、こういう状態はだいたいいつから続いていますか？ →「よくなったり悪くなったりで、2週間くらいです。」
items.speaker: admiral
choices: On and off for a couple of weeks now.
Pretty rough, to be honest.
Hopefully not much longer.
items.note: How long＝いつから続くか。程度や今後ではない

items.en: For a transfer that size, you'll need to come back with photo ID.
items.ja: その金額のお振込みですと、写真付きの身分証をお持ちのうえ、もう一度お越しいただく必要があります。 →「えっ、本当に？ 電話では誰もそんなこと言ってなかったのに。」
items.speaker: judy
choices: Seriously? Nobody told me that on the phone.
Sure, I can transfer the photo.
That size fits me fine, thanks.
items.note: that size＝その金額。服のサイズの話ではない

items.en: Have you tried bleeding the radiators? That usually does the trick.
items.ja: ラジエーターの空気抜きはしてみました？ たいていそれで直るんですが。 →「2回やりました。上のほうはまだ冷たいままです。」
items.speaker: cyrano
choices: Twice. They're still ice-cold at the top.
No, nobody's bleeding.
Sure, I'll turn the AC on.
items.note: bleed＝ラジエーターの空気抜き。血ではない

items.en: Delivery for 304. You want to buzz me in, or should I just leave it in the lobby?
items.ja: 304号室にお届けです。開けてもらえます？ それともロビーに置いときましょうか？ →「待って、下まで取りに行きます。」
items.speaker: kabuki
choices: Hang on, I'll come down and grab it.
Yes, I'll leave it in the lobby.
The lobby's buzzing tonight.
items.note: buzz in＝オートロックを開ける。置くのは配達員
items.tts: Delivery for three-oh-four. You wanna buzz me in, or should I just leave it in the lobby?

items.en: Did you bring your residence card, or just the passport?
items.ja: 在留カードはお持ちですか、それともパスポートだけですか？ →「パスポートだけです。それじゃ足りませんか？」
items.speaker: nana
choices: Just the passport. Is that not enough?
I've been a resident for two years.
Yes, I turned it in yesterday.
items.note: or just ～＝それとも～だけ？ 持参物で答える

items.en: Have you done an orientation yet, or are you good to just jump in?
items.ja: 初回のオリエンテーションは受けました？ それとも、このまま始めて大丈夫？ →「何年も筋トレしてるので、大丈夫だと思います。」
items.speaker: sterling
choices: I've lifted for years, so I think I'm good.
Good, thanks. How about you?
Sure, I'll jump in the pool.
items.note: jump in＝さっそく始める。are you good＝大丈夫？
items.tts: Have ya done an orientation yet, or are ya good to just jump in?

items.en: Should I take a little off your bangs while I'm at it, or are you growing them out?
items.ja: ついでに前髪も少し切りましょうか、それとも伸ばしてます？ →「そのままで。伸ばしてるところなんです。」
items.speaker: pekoe
choices: Leave them, please. I'm growing them out.
I'm going out later, actually.
Yes, I grew up around here.
items.note: bangs＝前髪（米）。grow out＝伸ばす

items.en: You know the recycling goes out on Wednesdays, right? Not Mondays.
items.ja: 資源ごみは水曜に出すって知ってるよね？ 月曜じゃなくて。 →「あっ、すみません！ 戻しておきます。」
items.speaker: frett
choices: Oh, sorry! I'll bring it back in.
Right, Monday works for me.
Sure, I know where it goes.
items.note: right? は確認の形の苦情。謝って対応する
items.tts: Ya know the recycling goes out on Wednesdays, right? Not Mondays.

items.en: Highway's quicker, but there's a toll. Want me to take it?
items.ja: 高速のほうが早いけど、有料だよ。乗る？ →「10分以上早いなら、お願いします。」
items.speaker: wolfgang
choices: If it saves more than ten minutes, sure.
Yes, I'll take it with me.
It's quicker to walk, I think.
items.note: take it＝高速を使う。toll＝通行料

items.en: It's about a four-hour wait right now, unless it's an emergency.
items.ja: 緊急でなければ、今は4時間ほどお待ちいただきます。 →「命に関わるほどではないので、アージェントケアに行ってみます。」
items.speaker: bea
choices: It's not life-threatening. I'll try an urgent care clinic.
Four o'clock? That's fine.
No, I've waited a moment already.
items.note: four-hour wait＝4時間待ち。時刻ではない

items.en: Your ticket's off-peak, I'm afraid. You'll have to pay the difference or get off at the next stop.
items.ja: 恐れ入りますが、こちらはオフピークの切符です。差額をお支払いいただくか、次の駅で降りていただくことになります。 →「わかりました。ここでカード払いできますか？」
items.speaker: portia
choices: Fine. Can I pay by card here?
Yes, I've paid off the ticket.
The next stop is mine as well.
items.note: off-peak 切符は時間帯制限。差額の払い方を聞く

items.en: I can be there in about forty minutes. The trip charge is ninety bucks before I even touch the lock.
items.ja: 40分くらいで行けるよ。鍵に触る前から出張料が90ドルね。 →「うわ、高いな。それって作業代とは別ですか？」
items.speaker: octavian
choices: Ouch. Is that on top of the actual job?
No, I locked it forty minutes ago.
I'll touch it before you get here.
items.note: trip charge＝出張料。before I even touch＝作業前に

items.en: The salmon? Mm, it's... a popular choice. The steak's really good tonight, though.
items.ja: サーモン？ うーん…人気はありますね。今夜はステーキがすごくおいしいですけど。 → サーモンより、ステーキを勧めている。
items.speaker: tangy
choices: She'd steer you toward the steak instead.
The salmon is the best thing on the menu.
The steak's sold out tonight.
items.note: popular choice の間(ま)と though が本音

items.en: We can certainly try to find you a quieter room, though we're pretty booked up this weekend.
items.ja: もちろん静かなお部屋をお探しいたしますが、今週末はかなり埋まっておりまして。 → 静かな部屋は、たぶん用意できない。
items.speaker: jacques
choices: A quieter room probably isn't available.
He'll move you to a quieter room right away.
The hotel is nearly empty this weekend.
items.note: certainly try～, though＝期待しないで、の含み

items.en: It's what I'd call cozy. Perfect if you don't have a lot of stuff.
items.ja: いわゆる「こぢんまり」ってやつですね。荷物が少ない方にはぴったりですよ。 → 部屋がとても狭い。
items.speaker: lopez
choices: The apartment is really small.
The apartment is warm and comfortable.
He thinks you own too much stuff.
items.note: cozy は不動産の婉曲語で「狭い」

items.en: The building has a lot of character. The elevator, for instance, has its own opinions.
items.ja: この建物はとても味がありましてね。たとえばエレベーターには、それなりの「こだわり」がありまして。 → 建物は古く、エレベーターもあてにならない。
items.speaker: cyrano
choices: It's an old building, and the elevator doesn't always work.
The elevator was just modernized.
The other tenants are very opinionated.
items.note: character＝古さの褒め言葉。エレベーターに意見＝気まぐれ

items.en: I can see why you'd think that. Unfortunately, the fee was in the terms you agreed to.
items.ja: そう思われるのもわかります。ただ残念ながら、その手数料はご同意いただいた規約に含まれていまして。 → 手数料は返金しない。
items.speaker: audie
choices: She won't refund the fee.
She agrees the fee was a mistake.
You need to agree to some new terms.
items.note: I can see why…＋Unfortunately＝共感してから断る

items.en: That's a solid weight for you. We can maybe think about going up... next month.
items.ja: 今の君には十分な重さだよ。上げるのは…来月あたりに考えようか。 → まだ重さを上げる段階ではない。
items.speaker: teddy
choices: You're not ready to lift more yet.
You should go up a weight today.
You've lifted too much and should stop.
items.note: next month の前の間(ま)が本音。今は上げない

items.en: Dr. Lee isn't taking new patients, but there's a clinic in Midtown that might have room.
items.ja: リー先生は新しい患者さんを受け付けていないんですが、ミッドタウンのクリニックなら空きがあるかもしれません。 → 別のクリニックを当たってほしい。
items.speaker: melba
choices: You'll have to try a different clinic.
Dr. Lee will see you in Midtown instead.
The clinic is moving to Midtown.
items.note: might have room＝よそを当たって、の意
items.tts: Doctor Lee isn't taking new patients, but there's a clinic in Midtown that might have room.

items.en: These tend to run a little small. You might want to try the next size up... or two.
items.ja: こちらは少し小さめの作りなんです。ワンサイズ上を試されては…いえ、ツーサイズかしら。 → かなり大きいサイズが必要だと思っている。
items.speaker: francine
choices: She thinks you need a much bigger size.
She thinks these are too big for you.
The next size up is out of stock.
items.note: run small＝小さめの作り。…or two が皮肉

items.en: Tip's included? Huh. Then why's there a line for 'additional gratuity'?
items.ja: チップ込み？ へえ。じゃあ、なんで「追加チップ」の欄があるわけ？ → チップを二重に払わされそうだと疑っている。
items.speaker: gulliver
choices: He suspects they're being asked to tip twice.
He's glad the tip is already included.
He wants to leave a bigger tip.
items.note: gratuity＝チップ。欄があるのを怪しんでいる

items.en: Hi, nobody answered, so I left it somewhere safe. Well, safe-ish. Behind the trash cans.
items.ja: どうも、お留守だったんで安全な場所に置いときました。まあ、そこそこ安全。ゴミ箱の裏です。 → 荷物は、あまり安全な場所にない。
items.speaker: al
choices: The package isn't really anywhere very safe.
The package has gone back to the warehouse.
He'll try to deliver it again later.
items.note: safe-ish＝まあまあ安全。ゴミ箱の裏が落ち

items.en: The app says our driver's two minutes away. It's also been saying that for, like, ten minutes.
items.ja: アプリだと運転手はあと2分だって。10分くらい前からずっとそう言ってるけどね。 → 運転手は、たぶんまだ近くない。
items.speaker: goldie
choices: The driver probably isn't that close.
The driver will be there in two minutes.
They have been in the car for ten minutes.
items.note: 2分と言いつつ「ずっとそう」＝当てにならない

items.en: I mean, I could patch it. But you'd be calling me again in a month.
items.ja: まあ、応急処置はできるよ。でも、1か月後にまた呼ぶことになるね。 → きちんと交換したほうがいい。
items.speaker: stitches
choices: Replacing it would be the better fix.
A patch will fix it for good.
He'll come back to check it next month.
items.note: could patch, but…＝応急処置では直らない
items.tts: I mean, I could patch it. But you'd be callin' me again in a month.

items.en: No, no, it's fine. I wasn't really planning on sleeping in this Saturday anyway.
items.ja: いえいえ、大丈夫ですよ。どうせ今週の土曜は朝寝坊するつもりもなかったので。 → 土曜朝の工事の音に怒っている。
items.speaker: henry
choices: He's annoyed about the noise on Saturday morning.
He doesn't mind because he gets up early.
He wants to help with the work on Saturday.
items.note: anyway の皮肉。本当は寝ていたかった

items.en: You can submit it today. Whether it gets processed before your flight... that I can't tell you.
items.ja: 今日提出はできます。ご出発までに処理されるかどうかは…そこはお約束できません。 → 出発までに間に合わないかもしれない。
items.speaker: bob
choices: It might not be ready before you leave.
It'll be processed before your flight.
You can't turn the form in today.
items.note: that I can’t tell you＝保証しない＝危ない

items.en: It's probably nothing, but I'd rather someone looked at it tonight than tomorrow.
items.ja: たぶん大したことはないと思いますが、明日より今夜のうちに誰かに診てもらうほうがいいですね。 → 今夜のうちに受診したほうがいい。
items.speaker: maple
choices: You should get it checked tonight.
It's nothing, so you can wait.
Someone will visit you tomorrow.
items.note: probably nothing, but…＝念のため今夜受診を

items.en: Bold choice! I mean, it'll grow back, right?
items.ja: 大胆ね！ まあ、また伸びるしね？ → その髪型を良いとは思っていない。
items.speaker: sylvia
choices: She has her doubts about the haircut.
She thinks the haircut looks perfect.
She's worried your hair won't grow back.
items.note: Bold choice!＋grow back が本音。褒めていない

items.en: Technically, this coupon expired yesterday. But... it's been a slow day.
items.ja: 厳密には、このクーポンは昨日で期限切れです。でも…今日は暇なので。 → 期限切れでもクーポンを使わせてくれる。
items.speaker: agnes
choices: She'll take the coupon anyway.
She can't accept the coupon.
The store is closing early today.
items.note: Technically…But＝規則上は無理、でも特別にOK

items.en: Dude, if this train's on time, I'll eat my hat.
items.ja: なあ、この電車が時間どおりに来たら、帽子でも食ってやるよ。 → 電車は絶対に遅れると思っている。
items.speaker: beau
choices: He's sure the train will be late.
He's hungry and wants something to eat.
He thinks the train will be on time.
items.note: I'll eat my hat＝絶対ありえない（慣用句）

items.en: I would've bought it, but they didn't have my size.
items.ja: 買うつもりだったけど、私のサイズがなかったの。
items.speaker: gayle
choices: would've
wouldn't have
will have
items.note: woulda＝would've。否定なら n が聞こえる
items.tts: I woulda bought it, but they didn't have my size.

items.en: Didn't you get the email about the bike trail being closed?
items.ja: サイクリングコースが閉鎖ってメール、届かなかったの？
items.speaker: kitt
choices: Didn't you
Did you
Don't you
items.note: didncha＝Didn't you。n の鼻音が手がかり
items.tts: Didncha get the email about the bike trail being closed?

items.en: I'd have to check with my manager first.
items.ja: まず店長に確認しないといけませんね。
items.speaker: label
choices: I'd have to
I have to
I had to
items.note: I'd hafta＝〜しないと。'd は弱く消えがち
items.tts: I'd hafta check with my manager first.

items.en: I must've left my card at the bar last night.
items.ja: ゆうべ、バーにカードを置いてきちゃったに違いない。
items.speaker: bob
choices: must've
might've
mustn't have
items.note: musta＝must've（きっと〜した）。確信度が違う
items.tts: I musta left my card at the bar last night.

items.en: We had to wait, like, three hours at immigration.
items.ja: 入国審査で、3時間くらい待たされたんだよ。
items.speaker: gulliver
choices: had to
have to
hate to
items.note: hadta＝had to。過去の話。hate to は「嫌だ」
items.tts: We hadta wait, like, three hours at immigration.

items.en: Would you mind moving your bag? That seat's reserved.
items.ja: お荷物をどけていただけます？ その席、予約済みなんです。
items.speaker: portia
choices: Would you mind
Do you mind
Did you mind
